import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    z = data[1]
    inside = False
    count = 0
    outsideMax = 0
    insideWords = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = z[i]
        i += 1
        if c == '_':
            if not inside:
                if count > outsideMax:
                    outsideMax = count
            else:
                if count > 0:
                    insideWords += 1
            count = 0
        elif c == '(':
            inside = True
            if count > outsideMax:
                outsideMax = count
            count = 0
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            if count > 0:
                insideWords += 1
            count = 0
        else:
            count += 1
    if not inside and count > outsideMax:
        outsideMax = count
    print(f"{outsideMax} {insideWords}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
